description:
A two bedroom terraced house situated on Gymnasium Street in Ipswich, offering good sized accommodation arranged over two floors and ideally located for access to the town centre and a range of local amenities.

GROUND FLOOR
The ground floor comprises of two reception rooms, providing flexible living and dining space, together with a kitchen and a downstairs family bathroom.

FIRST FLOOR
To the first floor are two double bedrooms, offering comfortable accommodation for a couple, small family or those looking for additional space for guests or working from home.

OUTSIDE
Externally, the property benefits from a rear patio area, providing a low maintenance outdoor space.

LOCATION
The property is conveniently situated close to Ipswich town centre, with a wide range of shops, supermarkets, restaurants and everyday amenities within easy reach.

For commuters, Ipswich railway station is approximately 0.8 miles away, providing regular rail services, including connections towards London Liverpool Street. The property also offers convenient access to the wider road network, including the A12 and A14.

An ideal opportunity for first-time buyers, investors or those seeking a conveniently located home close to the amenities and transport links of central Ipswich.

Council tax band - A
EPC rating - C
